title: kbgit.py sync appends one sync.gate row per run with each check's name, ran flag, skip reason, exit and ms, the scope and the push outcome
goal: kg_sync.py: every kbgit.py sync gate run records through ql_capture.record('ops', event='sync.gate', ms, checks=[{name, ran, why, exit, ms}], scope, files, push, exit) one row; a check skipped for 'no path it reads changed' appears with ran false and that reason; the selected test scope (the tests.py --changed summary: selected/total, 'all') and the push outcome (pushed, rejected, none) are in the row and printed once in the sync report so a gate that dropped its git scenarios names its scope; a capture failure never changes sync's exit. Tests in the NEW file _tools/test_ops_sync_gate.py: -k ops_sync_gate_row.
